title: Meet Anisa: Adhering to Care Plans With Help From Her Pals
summary: With Papa on her care team, Anisa can get to her life-saving infusions safely and continue to live on her own despite her diagnosis.
body_markdown: As Anisa’s disease progressed, the nausea during car rides became increasingly unbearable. Seven years ago, she became mostly homebound due to her MS symptoms, including the nausea, physical pain, and mobility challenges. Today, Anisa uses an electric wheelchair and gets her groceries and household items delivered. She conducts most of her medical appointments virtually or in her home—with the exception of her non-negotiable monthly infusions.
